calls.head: One power play bites, one doesn’t
calls.body: On the power play, Dallas is one of the league’s best and Buffalo is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
calls.call: The Stars’ power play creates more per 60 than the Sabres’.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: On power-play expected goals per 60, Dallas had 17.7 per 60 and Buffalo 2.2 per 60. Coming in, Dallas was at 8.8 per 60 and Buffalo at 7.1 per 60.
calls.beyond: Buffalo’s power play created 2.2 expected goals per 60, against their usual 7.1 and a league average of 7.5. A team strays this far about once every 15 games.

calls.head: Active D against forward-led
calls.body: On shots from defensemen, Dallas is around the middle of the league and Buffalo is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
calls.call: The Stars’ defensemen take a bigger share of the team’s shot attempts than the Sabres’.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: On share of 5-on-5 shot attempts taken by defensemen, Dallas had 19% and Buffalo 24%. Coming in, Dallas was at 35% and Buffalo at 34%.

BUF.head: We had this close to even (59% for Buffalo), and it went Dallas’s way.

DAL.head: We had this close to even (41% for Dallas), and Dallas came through.

surprises.head: Dallas leaned on their bottom six
surprises.body: Dallas’s bottom-six forwards played 46% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against their usual 41% and a league average of 42%. A team strays this far about once every 45 games.

surprises.head: J. Oettinger stole one
surprises.body: J. Oettinger allowed 0 goals on shots worth 2.4 expected goals, 2.4 fewer than expected. Starting goalies had a night this good about once every 25 starts over the last three seasons.

story.head: Oettinger shuts out the Sabres
paras: Jason Robertson opened the scoring midway through the first. Four different Stars scored. Jake Oettinger stopped all 26 shots.
The chances were closer than the score.

items.text: One of the preview’s two calls held.
